bio: I'm a versatile professional combining technical expertise with creative passion. As a software developer specializing in backend development and data analysis, I build robust applications and derive actionable insights from complex data.

Beyond code, I'm a passionate photographer and videographer who captures compelling visual stories. I also bring expertise in video editing using industry-standard tools like DaVinci Resolve, Blender, CapCut, and After Effects.
